title: Factorized Mirror codes for SIMoE sparse interpolation coefficients
hypothesis: Factorizing many sparse interpolation coefficient vectors reduces total SIMoE expert-bank bytes while preserving heldout expert outputs and using acceptable coefficient-generation compute.
mirror_coordinate: low-rank task code that generates sparse interpolation coefficients
controls: SIMoE raw sparse coefficient indices and values

development.selection_metric: heldout output nRMSE, total compressed payload bytes and coefficient-generation MAC

fresh.reason: native PCA is an exact functional control for the factorization

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: sparse indices and values or low-rank factors

success_gate: At least one factor rank preserves heldout output nRMSE <=0.02 with >=25% fewer complete bytes than raw sparse SIMoE codes, while reporting decode compute.
failure_gate: FAIL if raw sparse coefficients are smaller at matched quality, factorization misses quality, or native PCA exactly aliases Mirror.
boundaries: Synthetic linear anchor bank and sparse task coefficients only; no trained SIMoE or language-model result.
Sparse supports are generated per task and explicitly serialized in the raw SIMoE control.
The factorized code emits dense coefficient vectors unless support metadata is explicitly charged.
